proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.mixed_passive_and_reaction
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has two distinct mechanics that must coexist on the same attuned item: an always-on passive save advantage and a conditional reaction after a successful qualifying spell save. The current magic-item surface allows only PassiveMechanics or ActivatedAbilityMechanics, not both together.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells. ... you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.successful_spell_save_against_self
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is not triggered by being targeted or by a creature casting a spell in general. It is triggered only after you succeed on the saving throw for a spell, with additional predicates on spell level and targeting shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction

proposed_widenings.name: reflect_triggering_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing effect inventory can negate a triggering spell, but it cannot retarget and replay that triggering spell back at its caster using the caster's own spell save DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC

notes: Stopped before authoring content. A passive-only encoding would omit the core reaction rider; an activation-only encoding would lose the always-on save advantage. No honest trace is possible with the current surface.
